name: Lobbyist Compensation and Expenses by Source
description:
This dataset contains compensation and expense summaries from monthly lobbying reports. Includes one record per client who paid compensation or incurred expenses during the filing period. Records for lobbyist firm expenses not reimbursed by clients are also included. Reports with no compensation or expenses have no records in this dataset.

This dataset is a best-effort by the PDC to provide a complete set of records as described herewith and may contain incomplete or incorrect information. The PDC provides access to the original reports for the purpose of record verification.

Data Coverage and Limitations: The data set covers that prior 16 years plus the current election year starting 2016. Pre-2016 records are available in the separate "Pre-2016 Lobbyist Compensation and Expenses by Source" dataset. This is a best-effort compilation that may contain incomplete or incorrect information. Original reports remain accessible for record verification.

Descriptions attached to this dataset do not constitute legal definitions; please consult RCW 42.17A and WAC Title 390 for legal definitions and additional information regarding political finance disclosure requirements.

CONDITION OF RELEASE: This publication constitutes a list of individuals prepared by the Washington State Public Disclosure Commission and may not be used for commercial purposes. This list is provided on the condition and with the understanding that the persons receiving it agree to this statutorily imposed limitation on its use. See RCW 42.56.070(9) and AGO 1975 No. 15.

columns.name: id
columns.description: PDC internal identifier that corresponds to unique record for a lobbyist in a given year.

columns.name: report_number
columns.description: This is the identifying number of the filed L2 from the PDC Accesshub online filing system.

columns.name: origin
columns.description: This value shows how the report was filed: FE = Filed electronically; FP = Paper filed.

columns.name: filer_id
columns.description: The unique id assigned to a lobbyist. The filer id is consistent across years.

columns.name: filer_name
columns.description: The lobbyist's registered name. Names remain consistent for each filer within a given election year, but may vary between years if the lobbyist legally changes their name.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Shows if this report was filed for an employer or for a lobbyist.

columns.name: funding_source_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the contractual relationship between the firm and client.

columns.name: funding_source_name
columns.description: Name or label of the the contractual relationship between the firm and client.

columns.name: filing_period
columns.description: The filing period for this report.

columns.name: first_filed_at
columns.description: This indicates the first submission date of the L2 report.

columns.name: receipt_date
columns.description: The date that the report was filed.

columns.name: employer_id
columns.description: This ID consistently identifies a given lobbyist client/employer across all years in PDC records.

columns.name: employer_name
columns.description: The name of a given lobbyist client/employer referenced in the L2.

columns.name: compensation
columns.description: Total compensation reported for this client/employer for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: sub_lobbyist_compensation
columns.description: Payments made to other lobbyists who were hired by the lobbyist or paid by the lobbyist using funds received from the client/employer for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: net_compensation
columns.description: The total compensation the lobbyist received after paying any subcontracted lobbyists for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: personal_expenses
columns.description: The total amount of all personal expenses for travel, food and refreshments incurred by the lobbyist, from all employers for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: entertainment
columns.description: The total amount of expenditures incurred by the lobbyist or lobbyist client/employer(s) for legislators, state officials, state employees and members of their immediate families for this L2 and filing period. Expenditures include meals, beverages, tickets, passes, and other forms of entertainment; receptions; travel, lodging and subsistence expenses for speeches, presentations, appearances, trade missions, seminars or educational programs; and enrollment and course fees for seminars or educational programs.

columns.name: contributions
columns.description: The total amount of contributions to a Washington State candidate or committee that were given or transmitted by the lobbyist for this L2 and filing period. Contributions are described as monetary or in-kind, with in-kind being described as goods or services that were made directly to a political campaign, including political advertising that was coordinated with the campaign.

columns.name: advertising
columns.description: Deprecated field (legacy format only). The total amount of all advertising expenses incurred by the lobbyist, from all employers for this L2 and filing period. Advertising expenses include advertising costs, printing costs, and the cost of informational literature.

columns.name: political_ads
columns.description: Deprecated field (legacy format only). Total political advertising expenses across all employers for this L2 and filing period. Includes expenditures for political advertising supporting or opposing candidates/ballot measures, plus lobbying-related public relations, telemarketing, polling, and similar activities.

columns.name: independent_expenditures_candidate
columns.description: The total amount of independent expenditures made by the lobbyist or lobbyist's client (employer) in support of or opposition to any Washington State candidate that costs $1,000 or more for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: independent_expenditures_ballot
columns.description: The total amount of independent expenditures made by the lobbyist or lobbyist's client (employer) in support of or opposition to any Washington State ballot measure that costs $1,000 or more for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: other
columns.description: The total amount of other expenses incurred by the lobbyist, from all employers for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: direct_expenses
columns.description: The total amount of expenses directly related to lobbying the legislature or state agencies, such as printing and literature, public relations and polling, and consulting and payments to expert witnesses for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: indirect_expenses
columns.description: The total amount of indirect lobbying, or grassroots lobbying, involving campaigns funded by client/employer general treasury funds to encourage the public to contact their legislators for this L2 and filing period.

columns.name: contributions_total
columns.description: The total amount of contributions for the L2 and filing period.

columns.name: total_expenses
columns.description: The total amount of expenses incurred by the lobbyist for this L2 and reporting period, excluding compensation. This sum includes personal expenses, entertainment, contributions, advertising, political ads, independent expenditures (candidate and ballot measure), other expenses, and direct and indirect lobbying expenses.

columns.name: net_total
columns.description: The total of all expenses and compensation, minus any amount paid to a subcontractor to lobby on behalf of a client. Subcontractors report their own compensation and expenses.

columns.name: employment_registration_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the contractual relationship between the firm and client.

columns.name: employment_type
columns.description: Signifies a direct or subcontracted employment relationship.

columns.name: contractor_id
columns.description: The unique id assigned to a lobbyist. The contractor id is used to express when a lobbyist is sub contracted for another.

columns.name: contractor_name
columns.description: This is the contractor name, as reported on the filed L2.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Link to the original report filed with the PDC.
